categories.main_business_segments: Hunan Zhongke Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: lithium-ion battery anode materials and magnetic-electric equipment. The lithium battery segment focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of lithium-ion battery anode materials used in power, energy storage, and consumer electronics batteries. The magnetic-electric equipment segment involves the development, manufacturing, and sales of electromagnetic metallurgy equipment, industrial magnetic devices, and lithium battery specialized equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced graphite processing technologies, heat treatment processes, and graphite composite technologies in its lithium battery anode materials. It has developed a new generation of fully automated intelligent graphitization furnaces with advantages such as low power consumption, reduced core material costs, high automation, and environmental friendliness. The magnetic-electric equipment segment utilizes electromagnetic metallurgy technology, magnetic separation technology, electrical automation control, numerical simulation analysis, and engineering applications to maintain technological leadership.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers such as CATL, BYD, CALB, EVE Energy, Ruipu Lanjun, Hive Energy, ATL, LGES, SK On, and Samsung SDI. The end markets served are primarily the new energy vehicle market, energy storage market, and consumer digital electronics market. The magnetic-electric equipment segment serves steel enterprises, large metallurgical engineering contractors, transportation, shipbuilding, machinery, mining, and lithium battery industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in the East China, South China, Southwest, North China, Northwest, and Northeast regions. It is expanding its international presence by developing overseas production bases and has successfully entered international markets including South Korea. The company also plans overseas capacity expansion to mitigate trade and policy risks in Europe and the US.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hunan Zhongke Electric operates primarily upstream and midstream in the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on the production of key anode materials and specialized equipment manufacturing. It integrates the full process of anode material production and supports downstream battery manufacturers with advanced materials and equipment solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-performance graphite anode materials, including fast-charging, high energy density, and long-life products. It actively develops new materials such as silicon-carbon and hard carbon anodes and invests in intelligent manufacturing equipment. The magnetic-electric segment focuses on expanding applications in steel and lithium battery industries, enhancing green, low-carbon, and intelligent manufacturing technologies. The company also emphasizes internationalization and overseas capacity expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of lithium-ion battery anode materials and magnetic-electric equipment. The company follows an order-based production model with some inventory for market forecasting. It also earns government subsidies and investment income, but product sales constitute the core revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the lithium battery anode materials sector, main competitors include BTR, Shanghai Shanshan, Jiangxi Zichen, and Shangtai Technology. The company holds a strong third position in global anode material shipments and maintains a leading domestic market share. In electromagnetic metallurgy equipment, competitors include international firms like ABB and Danieli-Rotelec and domestic companies such as Kemeida and Longi. The company is a domestic leader with over 60% market share in continuous casting EMS equipment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately 5.58 billion RMB, a 13.72% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 303 million RMB, a 626.56% increase. The lithium battery materials segment accounts for over 93% of revenue. The company has a total asset base exceeding 11.3 billion RMB and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, reflecting a strong growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological leadership in graphite processing and intelligent manufacturing equipment, offering high-quality, stable, and cost-effective anode materials with superior fast-charging and energy density performance. Its integrated production capabilities and strong R&D partnerships provide competitive advantages. The magnetic-electric equipment segment differentiates through comprehensive product lines, advanced technology, and reliable quality, supporting green and intelligent manufacturing trends in steel and lithium battery industries.
